description: Source code for a documentation processing module, defining classes and functions for handling documentation structures, link patching, code group processing, and type parsing.

classes.name: Documentation
classes.description: Manages a collection of classes, supports merging, filtering by language, link rendering, and source code comment generation.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: Represents a documented class with members, properties, methods, events, and associated metadata.

classes.name: Member
classes.description: Represents a class member such as method, property, or event, with type information, arguments, and documentation.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Represents a data type with parsing, cloning, and filtering capabilities, including union and template types.

methods.name: mergeWith
methods.description: Merges current documentation with another, combining class definitions.

methods.name: copyDocsFromSuperclasses
methods.description: Copies documentation from superclasses, checking for overrides and undefined superclasses.

methods.name: filterForLanguage
methods.description: Filters classes and members based on specified programming language.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes classes and their members for quick lookup.

methods.name: setLinkRenderer
methods.description: Sets a custom link renderer and patches links within documentation nodes.

methods.name: renderLinksInNodes
methods.description: Replaces link placeholders in documentation nodes with actual links.

methods.name: renderLinksInText
methods.description: Replaces link placeholders in text with actual links using the patch function.

methods.name: generateSourceCodeComments
methods.description: Generates source code comments for documentation nodes.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the documentation object.
